name: iPhone Simulator — macOS Desktop Control
description: iOS Simulator control via macOS Accessibility. Every iOS UI element is exposed through AX, enabling full app automation and validation.

prerequisites: Xcode must be installed (provides Simulator + simctl)
Hide competing apps before automation: applescript 'set visible of process "Code" to false'
Get booted device UDID: xcrun simctl list devices booted
Connect hardware keyboard for type_text: key('shift+cmd+k')

decision_guide.tap_ios_element: click_text(windowId, 'label', offset_y=-25) — OCR-based, works for all visible text
decision_guide.tap_ios_button_by_ax: ui_press(pid, 'title') — faster but iOS elements often have no AX title
decision_guide.type_text_into_field: ui_set_value(pid, '{field_title}', 'text') — sets value via AX directly. BEST METHOD. type_text and clipboard paste are both BROKEN in simulator
decision_guide.navigate_url: bash: xcrun simctl openurl booted 'URL' — never type URLs manually
decision_guide.launch_app: bash: xcrun simctl launch booted {bundleId} — fastest and most reliable
decision_guide.device_controls: key() for Home/Lock/DarkMode/AppSwitcher. menu_click() for Rotate/FaceID/Location
decision_guide.permissions: bash: xcrun simctl privacy booted grant|revoke {service} {bundleId}
decision_guide.screenshot_for_app_store: bash: xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time '9:41' --batteryLevel 100, then key('cmd+s')
decision_guide.verify_ui_state: screenshot() for visual, ui_tree(pid) for AX elements, click_text to verify text exists
decision_guide.unlock_device: bash: xcrun simctl spawn {udid} notifyutil -p com.apple.springboard.unlockdevice + key('shift+cmd+h')
decision_guide.scroll_ios_list: scroll(direction, amount) on simulator window, or drag() for precise control
decision_guide.multi_device: bash: xcrun simctl boot {udid} — can run multiple simultaneously

simctl.description: xcrun simctl CLI commands for programmatic simulator control

errors.solution: Known bug — platform_explore doesn't detect Simulator. Use ui_tree(pid) + scan_menu_bar instead.

errors.pattern: type_text produces wrong characters (e.g. 'aaaaaaaaa' instead of 'apple.com')
errors.solution: type_text sends macOS key events which don't map correctly to iOS text fields. Workarounds: (1) Use simctl openurl for URLs, (2) Use simctl launch with args, (3) Use Edit > Paste with clipboard (applescript to set clipboard + cmd+v), (4) Ensure Connect Hardware Keyboard is ON (Shift+Cmd+K)

errors.pattern: Lock screen won't unlock with Home shortcut or drag
errors.solution: Use simctl to unlock: xcrun simctl spawn {udid} notifyutil -p com.apple.springboard.unlockdevice, then press Home (Shift+Cmd+H)

errors.pattern: iOS app icons show as unnamed AXButton in ui_tree
errors.solution: Home screen app icons don't expose titles via AX. Use click_text(windowId, 'AppName') with offset_y=-25 to click the icon above the label, or use simctl launch booted {bundleId}

errors.pattern: click_text hits wrong element due to Finder/background window text
errors.solution: Always hide competing apps first: applescript 'set visible of process X to false'. Use windowId param to scope OCR to simulator window only.

errors.pattern: scroll() doesn't scroll iOS content inside simulator
errors.solution: macOS scroll events don't propagate into iOS simulator content. Use drag(fromX, fromY, toX, toY) within the device screen area to simulate iOS swipe/scroll gestures.

errors.pattern: drag/swipe gestures don't work on iOS home screen or lock screen
errors.solution: iOS home screen swipe requires precise coordinates within the device bezel. Use simctl commands as alternatives (simctl openurl, simctl launch) instead of UI gestures.
